_note: Initiation/check-in prompts, keyed by cadence. Feed these into the new checkin-daily / checkin-weekly / checkin-monthly skills. Reword as invitations, not demands (PDA-aware).

prompts.question: What are your main goals for today?
Do you have any appointments or meetings to schedule?
Do you need to follow up on any communications today?
Are there any important deadlines coming up this week?
Are there any tasks you've been procrastinating on?
What self-care activities do you want to prioritize this week?
What tasks depend on other tasks or people?
What long-term projects do you need to make progress on this month?
Are there any skills you want to work on improving this month?
What do you want to achieve in your free time this month?
